description: Fazal Cloth Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 14 May 1966 and manufactures and sells yarn and fabric. Its eight spinning units — 274,524 spindles, 3,660 open-end rotors, 1,752 MVS spindles and 224 air-jet Picanol looms — sit at Fazal Nagar, Jhang Road, Muzaffargarh and at the Qadirpur Rawan Bypass on the Khanewal Road, Multan, with 54.06 MW of captive gas-fired generation. The company spins counts from Ne 4/1 to Ne 80/1 in cotton, rayon, polyester-cotton, modal-cotton and bamboo-cotton, and produces about 100,859 tons of yarn and 45.37 million metres of fabric a year.
sourceNote: Written from: fazalcloth.com — company profile and board of directors pages (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Yarn
products.summary: Carded, combed, compact, core-spun, multi-twist, multi-count, slub, double and zero-twist yarns in counts from Ne 4/1 to Ne 80/1, in cotton, rayon, polyester-cotton, modal-cotton and bamboo-cotton, including certified Supima, organic, Giza and BCI cottons and Lycra blends.

products.name: Fabric
products.summary: Fabric woven on 224 air-jet Picanol looms, with annual output of about 45.37 million metres.
